ros_sunray_adapter_route: PX4CTRL_CORE_PROFILE=dfbc_smooth_robust through Fast-Drone-250 px4ctrl LinearControl wrapper and MAVROS setpoint_raw/attitude

source_references.path: Docs/Paper/Quadrotor Trajectory Tracking Under Unknown Wind Disturbances via Differential Flatness and Smooth Bounded Robust Control.pdf
source_references.evidence: Paper combines differential-flatness feedforward, smooth bounded feedback, and disturbance-observer compensation for wind/uncertainty robustness; runtime wind and no-wind A/B are required before claiming benefit.

Open-source PX4/MAVROS outer-loop controller uses tanh boundary-layer feedback in an attitude-target output path; this is an engineering reference for bounded robust terms, not a substitute for the selected paper.
The airo_control_interface project documents PX4-based Gazebo/real-world outer-loop MPC, backstepping, and SMC controllers with MAVROS and QGC.
Diff-Planner publishes p/v/a/jerk/yaw/yaw_dot references for later planner-route validation.
LinearControl supports PX4CTRL_CORE_PROFILE=dfbc_smooth_robust and maps the smooth robust core to the MAVROS ATTITUDE_THRUST path while logging disturbance estimates in debug fields.

implemented_control_law: Compute smooth bounded feedback using tanh on a position/velocity tracking combination.
Estimate equivalent disturbance from measured acceleration residual derived from velocity samples and previous command acceleration.
Clamp disturbance compensation per axis before subtracting it from the bounded-feedback model acceleration.
Project compensated acceleration plus gravity to desired attitude and collective thrust.
Preserve high-order desired_body_rate and desired_body_acceleration diagnostic fields when jerk/snap references exist.
current_limitations: The current disturbance observer is an acceleration-residual engineering approximation, not a verified one-to-one transcription of the paper's observer equations.
Wind disturbance is not yet injected in the Gazebo A/B matrix for this controller.
Current runtime output is still ATTITUDE_THRUST; no body-rate, torque, or rotor-level robust control path has been released.
The public author-code route for this exact paper was not confirmed; local PDF formulas are the primary source and open-source SMC/DOB code is only engineering context.
first_runtime_ab_required: Diff-Planner single-UAV after basic trajectory gates pass
known_failure_modes: Acceleration residuals can be noisy when odometry velocity rate or timestamps are degraded.
Observer reset/sign mistakes can overcompensate and increase tracking error.
Smooth bounded feedback may under-drive aggressive tracking if bounds are too conservative.
Runtime improvement may only appear under wind/disturbance profiles and may not improve nominal no-wind figure8.
